light_medium.label: light
light_medium.description: Simple, unambiguous operations with an established solution.

light_high.label: light
light_high.description: Bounded implementation or search requiring reasoning.

heavy_high.label: heavy
heavy_high.description: Complex implementation, diagnosis, or ambiguous tasks. Prefer this over light when uncertain.

heavy_xhigh.label: heavy
heavy_xhigh.description: Architecture, security, data integrity, or difficult cross-system decisions. Reserve for tasks needing this depth, not every task.
